display_name: ETF Faber Tactical Asset Allocation (SHADOW PILOT, n<30)
philosophy: Implements Mebane Faber's canonical 5-asset Tactical Asset Allocation (SSRN 962461, 2007/2013). Long when monthly close > 10-month SMA; cash otherwise. INCIDENT_ETFS #1 + Ring consult identified this as the strongest academic backing for ETF. Shadow-pilot only — the existing etf_scanner is a KILL-CANDIDATE (PF=0 on n=2 energy concentration); etf_rsi2_pullback is n=1 win. We need an academically grounded ETF emitter to break INSUFF-N stasis.
entry_criteria: Symbol in {SPY (US eq), EFA (intl eq), IEF (bonds), VNQ (REITs), DBC (commodities)}
Re-evaluate ONLY on month-end close (avoid intra-month noise)
exit_criteria: Hard time-stop: 60 trading days (ETF resolution window aligned to monthly cadence)
ATR stop: 3x 20-day ATR (Faber uses time-based exits primarily; ATR as guardrail)
suggested_backtesting_protocol: Faber 5-asset universe monthly bars 2007-2025. Walk-forward. Compare to 60/40 and to AGG hurdle. n>=30 per-symbol closed picks required before promotion.
confidence_calibration: MEDIUM only until n>=30. Faber's published live track record is well-known (SSRN replications) but our forward-test sample is zero — treat as unproven on THIS stack.
best_market_conditions: Persistent trending regimes across asset classes
